notes.title: Developer Update #5 - 25/09/2025
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, Survivors![/h1]

[h2]Welcome to our fifth Developer Update! Today, we’re excited to share a big look at what’s been cooking behind the scenes. Let’s dive right in![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/0ebbc6356ed04ccf188d9321bab0c033f4f2a593.png[/img]

[h3]Male Character & Armors[/h3]

Up until now, the female character has been leading the way, but it’s time for reinforcements. The male character is officially joining the fight! Alongside this, we’re unveiling one of the biggest gameplay systems yet: armors. 🔥

Here’s a first look at two new armor sets designed for the male archetype, each offering distinct stats and playstyles to shape your survival strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/c31335c9654004492c4b3bd29f289db45d8d607e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/bc40fbb217b998c2bf6941fc58255ad2b87c2221.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all. Some of you eagle-eyed explorers may have spotted a motorbike in our last trailer 👀. Vehicles are a huge milestone for mobility, but we wanted to give you something to bridge the gap while exploring our vast worlds. Enter: backpacks! 🚀

Each backpack comes equipped with its own jetpack, giving you new ways to move, scout, and survive with style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/991e25945ccadac8459e69e7254b99a0c75e75df.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/439295db066fcdad5b4b393c0d891046831e6006.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/be449989df0c3119e923eddd4679bf6afc50dde2.gif[/img]

[h3]Environment Concept Art[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/04aada18f76a2797346bcf844237a822d338f8cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/32558aa738503a28b980436d894ecf7c6a753a6d.png[/img]

Take a peek at some brand-new concept art showcasing the resources of [b]Land of Symbiosis[/b]. 🌱

Alien plants will cover your essential survival needs, while rarer resources are the key to advanced progression, powering up your base, unlocking cutting-edge tech, crafting stronger armors, and forging weapons with serious bite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/88673dbc7cf65057779269578a251e61eb83c3b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/fa5d0206b5137293e2974605864397e4d82cc8ae.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/116a73ffc47c737c9a4625dd7af85c3d32fb3b74.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/d43ddb3f56a14cfa69d76916d7718d183a8fc03f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/70bcedcc5e12667ed3fb4dc87d9746071e14e327.jpg[/img]

[h2]That’s all for this update![/h2]

We hope you enjoyed this look at what’s coming to [b]Land of Symbiosis[/b]. Development is moving fast, and we can’t wait for you to get your hands on these new systems soon.  

✅ Don’t forget to [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b], it’s the best way to support us and stay up to date.  

Thanks,
[i][b]~Land of Symbiosis Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: New Alien Creature Inspired by Event Winner!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there, Survivors![/h1]

[h2]We’re excited to reveal a brand-new creature inspired by Grey, winner of the Alien Evolution Event![/h2]

When we saw Grey’s creation, “Stinkler,” we knew right away it belonged in *Land of Symbiosis*. It was such an inspiring design that we immediately started bringing it to life in-game!  

[h3][b]Concept Art from Alien Evolution Event Winner Grey:[/b][/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/4f2fd5aa13e3e4ab606682c845feb56665039788.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Our 3D model implemented into the game:[/b][/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/93658f6f524c71ede1d5e76e2e1207972eeb72a2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/87d3d8ab44a8207e91003f6c19941ec8ba64c098.png[/img]

We want to extend a huge thank you for your continued support and creativity. Events like this wouldn’t be possible without our amazing community. 💙  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/664ec46cc07459fdb219f5d18a0914f583cfa776.jpg[/img]

[h2]That’s all for this update![/h2]

We hope you enjoyed this first look at Grey’s incredible creature, now coming to [b]Land of Symbiosis[/b]. Community-driven content like this makes the world feel more alive, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.  

✅ Don’t forget to [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b], it’s the best way to support us and never miss an update.  
✅ Join our [b]Discord community[/b] to take part in future events, share feedback, and connect with other Survivors.  

[i][b]~ Land of Symbiosis Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Developer Update #4 - 15/07/2025
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, Survivors![/h2]

[h2]Today, we are coming to you with a fourth Developer Update to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/e651f245194c2c6c92ec9049868f8ea69fa1d27a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Concept Art[/b][/h3]

This month, the art team has been busy refining key visuals that shape the atmosphere of our world. New mood and biome-specific palettes, helping us nail down the look and feel of Sigma Century’s alien flora and environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/96e9331e28f2ba0690bdea0d8d5a44073df173ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/f3e28aa3f1fca2ce429b74472f5bbcd26490b002.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/ba76e2d28bfb60ff2ff74bbdda3dedf49a6e82ba.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/14213352a689a3fd4fdfc53c220ceb356f835844.png[/img]

[h3][b]Environnements[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/b582fb934d2e69ac1b9411b09a2be8cc1a883acd.jpg[/img]

[i]Not in-game footage, work in progress paint over of the creature's nest design.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/16a11c8540f5b0fc645c22d8771190121207c050.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/deef1975b11ab7d01b388a42d3fa5b7bf9e248c8.png[/img]

Some more iterations on our procedural environment pipeline. Now including large rock formations, modular terrain features, and vegetation clusters that dynamically adapt to each biome. This will help us keep environments fresh and varied throughout the game.

[h3][b]Creatures[/b][/h3]

Animation tests for our new creatures are in progress! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/4dc8bb1fe6a5b3c5d527a0a215eb2f8c7662e224.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/fca3c696bfac2fae1ef08cc508c50ee5dff37a08.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/d939a7e4331815fb4172a28783f8f351265bb637.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/5f436373c6809901debf2cdec319a5860feecbbe.gif[/img]

[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/065aa5009f9b22fe6bc44e579b0d8d1d6bbfadcc.png[/img]

Initial layout mockups are underway for the user interface around the Cycles, one of the game’s core pillars.

These cycles influence whether you’ll venture out to gather resources, hunt creatures roaming the world, or stay back and pray your base holds against the incoming swarm.

We’re prototyping different ways to present this information clearly and make sure players feel the pressure (and opportunity) each cycle brings.

[h3][b]Defenses[/b][/h3]

This week, we introduced the Turret Mk1 to our defensive toolkit.
It’s designed as an early-game, low-cost option: helpful for fending off small creatures or stray threats, but intentionally kept quite weak, so players still need to stay alert and actively defend their base.

The team is now playtesting its range, firing rate, and visual feedback to make sure it feels useful without making the early game too easy.

[b]Concept[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3350f575ad03747cc51ad098471bd8c89784955b.png[/img]

[b]In progress modeling & texturing[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/23429553f3fd3baaddbdc8d0e8635cf78749a561.png[/img]

[h3][b]In Game previews[/b][/h3]

We’ve got some fresh in-game shots to share!
They show our new creature animations and early environment passes coming together. It’s still a work-in-progress, but it feels great to see things starting to click visually.

What do you think? We’d love to hear your first impressions and feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3c1e60b7c9624264630b2b17563fe02e34f44023.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/2870bc648b7463ab39bba367a057c38fae808d65.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/5fa399be9b11f6161930df2251d75286ee912a53.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developer Update #3 - 18.06.2025
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, Survivors![/h2]

[h2]Today, we are coming to you with the third Developer Update to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/77e80dda8b7bf0578b9e003f01574eac300cfe77.png[/img]

[h3][b]Environment[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/878243ae940604ff289e49205f9a8bfd3ed16e2a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/12216bc236a082b8b07fdbc313bbba032d5cd8e6.png[/img]

[b]Our latest environment concept art is now finalized. What do you think?[/b]

With that in place, we've started building the rocky sub-biome you'll explore while searching for rare materials! It’s still early, but we’re excited to share the results as they evolve. The rocks are heavily inspired by Icelandic formations, with curved elements used to enhance the flow and dynamism.

[h3][b]Concept Art[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/78cf1b309b5ca5952fbe699220b573addbaf4fc3.jpg[/img]

[b]We're working on “TAPER”, one of the first threats you’ll encounter.[/b]

It’s a bit dumb (not many brain cells left), but still accurate enough to tear through your defences. Watch out!

[h3][b]3D Modeling[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/05f5290216e8cbc5043dfb0dcbe3dd3f6a22b20f.png[/img]

[b]Admire BULK’s final 3D form! 😄[/b]

With his massive arms and tank-like build, he's ready to smash through bases and soak up damage like a champ.

Now fully textured, he looks even cooler, and at four times the size of FLESH, BULK will be a real threat during swarm phases.

He naturally draws your defences' focus, which makes him the perfect distraction… while smaller creatures slip through.

[h3][b]Animation[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/65e8bec05fcaf621b791860838e3189124886a40.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/e3e1466648d99029fb2687ac0e10bfaae64abf1b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/c2e39269dad6026b58beded859780c7fa6c95050.gif[/img]

[b]We’re working on the first animations for FLESH,[/b]
and we can’t wait to get them in-game to show you how it all comes to life!

[h3][b]Development - New Weapon![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/2938396e08ce55cfdbdb7422aa88f88645d74524.jpg[/img]

[b]We’ve been working on one of the first weapons you’ll be able to craft the good old Crossbow Mk1.[/b]
It’s not the most efficient tool out there, but hey, it’s still a big step up from using your fists!

[h3][b]Development - Research bench rework[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/b4b3c5e197c6b9e65d01b5aa373eee5ea0457720.png[/img]

[b]We have reworked the research bench a little bit lately, mostly UX/UI and localization support.
[/b]

[h3][b]Development Misc[/b][/h3]

We are also working on a lot of dev features that are not always so amusing to show, sadly. Here is still a small list of what we did : 
[list]
[*] Camera-based procedural splat map generation for terrain texturing
[*] Rework of the world entities layers and erasing system for generation
[*] A whooooole lot of new SFX for base building
[*] Reintegration of the hot bar and new UX designs
[*] A lot more work on localization
[/list]

[b]If that interests you, feel free to join our Discord and discuss with our developers directly! 😀
[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/SpZN2bX57b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/70bcedcc5e12667ed3fb4dc87d9746071e14e327.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developer Update #2 - 05.06.2025
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey there, Survivors![/b][/h3][p][/p][h2]Today, we have a second Developer Update to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/7cc7cf1cbb1b33451a9b00fb44f69c20acd5f08b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Creatures[/h3][p][/p][p]- [b]Finalized BULK Concept arts[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/ebe3f5c916f1111f77206a43515ab20626fcd1b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/a63fddc9e01e43a334f89e58c0615cadfca0fc73.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to his massive arms, BULK will be able to smash your base and defenses while being an incredibly resistant creature. A living tank.[/p][p]We also like to think he has some vibes of a good boy [/p][p](His design is partially doggo.)[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]WIP BULK 3D Modeling[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/8de4f14da4d716a1a97133a4c98c356d1c22a3f5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/63c5afab82a37fa1427619322d7cbb87362bc251.png"][/img][/p][p]Last week, we started the blocking phase of BULK. As you can see, it’s challenging to get the proportions right, especially since the back and arm armor must fit together for the shield assembly (see concepts above).[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]FLESH enemy modeling & texturing is now complete![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/34f413f1b2f20982a0c944015b73806436407d91.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here’s a first look at the final sculpt and textures. We went for a sharp, aggressive silhouette with glowing inner details to give it a menacing presence.[/p][p][/p][p]At the same time, we focused on clean readability, as these creatures will often appear in large groups; it's essential that players can quickly identify and react to them in the heat of battle. What do you think of the look?[/p][p][/p][h3]Environment[/h3][p][/p][p]- [b]WIP environment concepts[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/85564931f44528d6349f2ded5b869558feead318.png"][/img][/p][p]We've made solid progress on the environment![/p][p]This is 3D blockout for our next concept art, which will feature ground rifts and more dramatic rock formations. It's still rough, but we're excited about the direction we're taking. What do you think?[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some color variations, feel free to mark your favourite![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/83f30381250aab02535c0a1be9c79a29314d1c03.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Localization[/h3][p][/p][p]As part of our preparation for an upcoming event 😶‍🌫️, we've been working on localizing Land of Symbiosis into new specific languages. While there's still some polishing to do, the localization systems are already in place.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, the Q3 playtest will be available in the following languages:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p] English[/p][/*][*][p] French[/p][/*][*][p] German[/p][/*][*][p] Spanish[/p][/*][*][p] Russian[/p][/*][*][p] Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p] Japanese[/p][/*][*][p] Korean[/p][/*][*][p] Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Network optimisations[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3b0d03d1b5b6766f9c5c98cbf71dd0c95733494f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Performance is a core priority in Land of Symbiosis, especially since we aim to simulate hundreds, if not thousands, of enemies simultaneously.[/p][p][/p][p]To support this, we've implemented a system that pre-computes major navigation data during the server’s initial loading phase. This significantly reduces runtime overhead and improves in-game performance despite having a runtime-generated procedural world.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, we've optimised how static elements of the environment are handled. These elements are now excluded from the network entirely, relying instead on the world seed and procedural generation to pre-pool them locally on each client. This approach reduces bandwidth usage and minimises latency when loading chunks around the player while increasing memory usage slightly for the client.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your time and support. We hope you liked our new Developer update! See you in the next one![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/664ec46cc07459fdb219f5d18a0914f583cfa776.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Development Update #1 - 20/05/2025
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, Survivors![/h2]

Today, we are coming to you with a quick DevUpdate to keep you in the loop on our development progress! Let's jump into it!

[h2]Creatures[/h2]

- New creature named “B.U.L.K.” concepts

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3e3a265a00d4f8c8a4f04cf73522a86ac286096b.png[/img]

BULK stands for “Bulwark Unstoppable Lifeform Kolossus” and will be one of the first monsters to truly test your abilities in combat and base defense setup. Its shell on his back and arms allows him to take the form of a living shield, luring your defenses while smaller creatures can destroy them in the meantime.

- Finalised creature “F.L.E.S.H.” concepts

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/7f50ec0a9c21b60b400b048252d1e197d63c6cb3.jpg[/img]

FLESH stands for “Functional Living Entity for Sacrificial Hostilities” 
They behave like ants,  fast, disposable, and individually weak, but extremely dangerous when swarming in massive groups. As the first enemy players will face, they serve as an early stress test for defences and demand quick area control and positioning.

Work in progress FLESH 3D modeling

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/3446489a0bf6cf6df48f4b6ad4f45910d60146ae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/15ee12b679fb492b2ae2f7201da533ca56ba7431.jpg[/img]

High Poly modeling ✅ | Low Poly ⌛| Mid Poly ⌛| Texturing ⌛

[h2]Environment[/h2]

- Environment Design work in progress

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/dbed0525f4fd325584a217ffc48c2f799293501b.png[/img]

We are working on some new moods and assets for the first environment you will encounter.

[h2]World[/h2]

Regarding the world, some improvements were made; we have been working on navigation baking and network optimizations to make sure the game runs as fast as possible during gameplay. This is important for us, given the number of enemies you can encounter during swarm cycles.

We are also working on a new system regarding procedural generation of the forests. This new system will allow us to generate more realistic-looking vegetation placement around trees using SDFs and hierarchies while being fully customizable by our artists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/6d7c1ab2e49bc090a4db7f092efb8ce54eb934f6.png[/img]

[h2]Base Building[/h2]

For those of you that tested the game during the first closed playtest. You will notice a huge change in the base building mechanic. We heard your feedback and worked on a more modular, fun and creative base building system.

This new system is based on a 1x1 grid and not on a 4x4 grid anymore. This allows the player to create everything he wants, giving a lot more of creativity for base defense and decoration.

[b]Temporary visuals[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/4559e75826b3e55fcac43ffa1ad79f320ebdf8e2.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]Fog Of War[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/a43126cf272b88516967f87099399b735d6e9a84.gif[/img]

We developed more visually interesting effects and introduced a new, lightweight method for handling fog of war.

Traditionally, fog of war is implemented by painting circular masks onto a texture that represents the world from a top-down view. This texture is then used to display explored areas. However, saving and transmitting this texture, especially when a player joins a game in progress, can be costly in terms of memory and bandwidth.

Our approach subdivides the world into cells. Whenever a player enters a new cell, we mark it as visited.

 We then dispatch a compute shader that generates a render texture at runtime using smoothmin functions based on the center positions of the visited cells.

 💾 This allows us to save and transmit only the IDs of the visited cells to each client, who can then generate the fog of war texture locally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027493/0bc5d17ea3e29c0d2ab8f19e55ac5f8464203678.png[/img]

Would you be interested in a detailed devlog about procedural generation? This is quite a huge topic, and we could share a lot of interesting insights about it!

tags.feature: - New creature named “B.U.L.K.” concepts
- Finalised creature “F.L.E.S.H.” concepts
Work in progress FLESH 3D modeling
- Environment Design work in progress
We are working on some new moods and assets for the first environment you will encounter.
Regarding the world, some improvements were made; we have been working on navigation baking and network optimizations to make sure the game runs as fast as possible during gameplay.
This is important for us, given the number of enemies you can encounter during swarm cycles.
We are also working on a new system regarding procedural generation of the forests.
This new system will allow us to generate more realistic-looking vegetation placement around trees using SDFs and hierarchies while being fully customizable by our artists.
For those of you that tested the game during the first closed playtest. You will notice a huge change in the base building mechanic.
We heard your feedback and worked on a more modular, fun and creative base building system.
This new system is based on a 1x1 grid and not on a 4x4 grid anymore.
This allows the player to create everything he wants, giving a lot more of creativity for base defense and decoration.
We developed more visually interesting effects and introduced a new, lightweight method for handling fog of war.
Traditionally, fog of war is implemented by painting circular masks onto a texture that represents the world from a top-down view.
This texture is then used to display explored areas.
However, saving and transmitting this texture, especially when a player joins a game in progress, can be costly in terms of memory and bandwidth.
Our approach subdivides the world into cells.
Whenever a player enters a new cell, we mark it as visited.
We then dispatch a compute shader that generates a render texture at runtime using smoothmin functions based on the center positions of the visited cells.
This allows us to save and transmit only the IDs of the visited cells to each client, who can then generate the fog of war texture locally.
